# Migration-Readiness Requirements Quality Checklist: Bootstrap & Cleanup — MUI Migration Phase 0

**Purpose**: Validate that all requirements for Phase 0 (dependency cleanup, dead code removal, MUI theme setup) are complete, unambiguous, and measurable before implementation planning
**Created**: 2026-05-07
**Feature**: [spec.md](./spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command. Items validate requirement quality, not implementation correctness.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Is the complete list of packages to REMOVE enumerated with exact package names, or does FR-005 leave ambiguity about which specific @radix-ui/* packages are included? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are the exact versions of all KEPT dependencies specified (motion, lucide-react, date-fns), or only MUI/Emotion versions in FR-014? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK003 - Is the exhaustive list of files in src/styles/ documented in the spec, or does FR-006 rely on implementation-time discovery? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are requirements defined for handling the `pnpm` field in package.json's `overrides` section, or only pnpm-workspace.yaml and pnpm-lock.yaml? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK005 - Is the expected `packageManager` field value in package.json specified (e.g., `yarn@4.9.2`), or is "Yarn Berry v4+" sufficient? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK006 - Are requirements for tsconfig.node.json (companion to tsconfig.json) defined, or is only tsconfig.json addressed in FR-015? [Gap, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK007 - Is the `typecheck` script expected in package.json specified as a requirement, or is it an implementation detail? [Completeness, Gap]
- [ ] CHK008 - Are peerDependencies and peerDependenciesMeta requirements for react/react-dom defined, or is this left to implementation discretion? [Gap]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK009 - Is "exactly 9 production dependencies" in SC-001 precise about what counts (e.g., does React itself count, or only non-React deps)? [Clarity, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is the phrase "dark emerald/gold palette" in FR-007 quantified with exact hex values for ALL palette entries (primary, secondary, error, background, text)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK011 - Is "Emotion cache" in FR-008 clarified — does ThemeProviderWrapper need an explicit Emotion CacheProvider, or does MUI v7 handle this internally? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is the expected behavior of `yarn build` after cleanup clearly defined: should it exit 0 (with errors), exit non-zero, or is only "no Vite plugin errors" the bar? [Clarity, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK013 - Is the scope of "dead files" in FR-006 exhaustive, or could there be other dead files (e.g., in root, guidelines/, etc.) not listed? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK014 - Are the Google Fonts URL parameters specified (weights, display=swap), or is "Google Fonts CDN in index.html" sufficient? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK015 - Is SC-001 ("exactly 9 production dependencies") consistent with FR-011 ("keep these dependencies" listing 7 packages) — are the 2 missing ones react and react-dom as peer dependencies? [Consistency, Spec §SC-001, §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK016 - Is FR-006 (delete src/styles/) consistent with the clarification about main.tsx — does FR-009 (update main.tsx to wrap in ThemeProviderWrapper) also cover removing the CSS import, or is that implicit? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK017 - Does FR-010 (remove Tailwind CSS plugin) align with FR-012 (keep figmaAssetResolver) — are these the ONLY two plugins in vite.config.ts, or could there be others? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK018 - Is the Edge Case about "CSS custom properties defined in theme.css" consistent with FR-006 (delete all of src/styles/) — are there any CSS custom properties used outside src/styles/ that need handling? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-006]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK019 - Is SC-004 ("MUI theme renders with correct dark palette") measurable without a running browser, or does it require manual DevTools inspection? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK020 - Is SC-006 ("Vite dev server starts without plugin errors") objectively verifiable, or is "plugin errors" ambiguous — does it mean zero console warnings or zero fatal errors? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK021 - Can SC-003 ("zero .tsx files in src/app/components/ui/") be verified with a single command, or does it also need to account for subdirectories or non-.tsx files? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK022 - Are the acceptance scenarios in User Story 1 (3 scenarios) traceable to specific FRs, or are they free-standing without requirement linkage? [Traceability, Spec §User Story 1]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK023 - Are requirements defined for the scenario where `node_modules/` doesn't exist yet (first-time clone) — is `yarn install` expected to work from scratch? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK024 - Are requirements defined for the scenario where a developer has uncommitted changes when running the cleanup — should there be a warning or stash requirement? [Coverage, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK025 - Is there a requirement for git commit strategy — should Phase 0 be a single atomic commit or multiple commits per group (A–I)? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK026 - Are requirements defined for what happens to existing TypeScript errors in component files that reference deleted imports — is the error message quality a concern? [Coverage, Edge Case]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK027 - Is the scenario where pnpm-lock.yaml does NOT exist (only pnpm-workspace.yaml) explicitly addressed as a requirement, or only as a clarification answer? [Edge Case, Spec §Clarifications Q7]
- [ ] CHK028 - Are requirements defined for .gitignore entries that may already exist vs. need to be appended — is duplicate entry prevention specified? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK029 - Is the scenario where tsconfig.json already exists (but may not have strict: true) covered by FR-015, or does it only say "create if missing"? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK030 - Is the scenario where src/app/components/figma/ImageWithFallback.tsx uses Tailwind classes addressed — the Assumptions say keep it, but does FR-006 conflict? [Edge Case, Spec §Assumptions, §FR-006]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK031 - Are performance requirements for `yarn install` time defined (e.g., should complete in under 60 seconds), or is SC-002 ("completes without errors") sufficient? [NFR, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK032 - Are accessibility requirements for the MUI theme specified (e.g., color contrast ratios for gold on dark emerald), or is that deferred to a later spec? [NFR, Gap]
- [ ] CHK033 - Is a bundle size target after cleanup defined as a requirement, or is SC-001's dependency count the only size proxy? [NFR, Spec §SC-001]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK034 - Is the assumption that "no app component imports from components/ui/" verified as a requirement, or is it an unvalidated assumption that could cause runtime issues? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK035 - Is the dependency on Spec 002 (component migration) for a working app clearly documented as a blocker, or could Phase 0 be misinterpreted as producing a functional app? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK036 - Is the Node.js version requirement specified (e.g., 18+), or is this an implicit assumption? [Assumption, Gap]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK037 - Does FR-008 ("ThemeProvider + CssBaseline + Emotion cache") conflict with MUI v7's default behavior where Emotion cache is auto-managed by ThemeProvider? [Conflict, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK038 - Is there a conflict between SC-001 ("9 production dependencies") and the reference spec listing 7 kept packages — are react/react-dom counted as production deps or peer deps? [Conflict, Spec §SC-001, §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK039 - Does the term "dead files" in FR-006 include the guidelines/ directory, ATTRIBUTIONS.md, or other Figma-export artifacts, or only the explicitly listed files? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK040 - Is the `packageManager` field value aligned with the Yarn Berry v4+ requirement — does "v4+" mean the latest stable, or a specific minor version? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-001]
